title: ColorPicker: Can't scroll through color history swatches using a touchpad

judgment.rationale: The mouse-wheel control narrows the defect to gesture routing/native scroll-axis behavior, not a missing wheel handler. Reproduce precision-touchpad manipulations separately before choosing horizontal-mode constraints or gesture translation.
evidence: The report says two-finger touchpad input bobs the horizontal swatch list vertically.
Mouse wheel vertical and horizontal scrolling work; the report is assigned to niels9001.

Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/colorPicker/ColorPickerUI/Views/ColorEditorView.xaml: HistoryColors uses a horizontal ItemsStackPanel and hides the horizontal scrollbar, but this declaration does not explicitly disable vertical scrolling/manipulation.

Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/colorPicker/ColorPickerUI/Views/ColorEditorView.xaml.cs: HistoryColors_OnPointerWheelChanged already changes HorizontalOffset using MouseWheelDelta and marks the event handled; precision touchpad manipulation may not take this event path.
No physical precision-touchpad test was performed; the source distinction supports an input-path investigation rather than proof of a specific gesture fix.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce Color Picker touchpad history behavior

fix_assessment.rationale: Conditional lightweight proposal, not an implementation-grade design. The separate wheel handler and reported wheel/touchpad differential are concrete, but native gesture routing has not been measured.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep Color Picker history gestures on the horizontal axis
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: precision-touchpad manipulation follows the ListView/ScrollViewer native axis path rather than the explicit mouse-wheel-to-horizontal handler, allowing unwanted vertical movement.
plan: Compare touchpad manipulation/view-change events with PointerWheelChanged on an overflowing history list.
Inspect actual horizontal/vertical scroll and chaining modes; identify whether gestures bypass translation or leave a vertical viewport enabled.
Constrain the proven unwanted axis or route the gesture consistently without double-applying native and wheel deltas.
verification: Two-finger touchpad gestures traverse all history swatches without vertical bobbing.
Vertical/horizontal mouse wheels, keyboard selection, context menus and selected-item visibility remain correct.

confidence.rationale: The separate wheel handler and reported wheel/touchpad differential are concrete, but native gesture routing has not been measured.
